name: MASSIVE: A 1M-Example Multilingual Natural Language Understanding Dataset
description: MASSIVE (Multilingual Amazon Slu resource package) is a massively multilingual spoken language understanding dataset spanning 51 typologically diverse languages across 18 domains. It contains 19,521 realistic user utterances per language (totaling 995,571 examples) annotated for intent classification (60 intents) and slot-filling (55 slot types), allowing robust cross-lingual evaluation and benchmarking of task-oriented dialog models.
